_comment: C0-9 正文英译 · linear-mcp（2026-10-25）。无 extraSections（内置五节由 axes/leads/runs/unknowns/related 承载）。

axes.model_access:
**It calls no model itself** — an interface implementation called by MCP clients. It wraps Linear issue management
(searching issues, creating/updating issues, querying projects and teams) as tools for agents.
axes.runtime:
Official hosted remote server (mcp.linear.app/mcp — direct fetch 401 = exists but needs auth; the old /sse endpoint 404 —
the transport line has changed generations, direct-fetched and verified 2026-10-21).
axes.local_files: Never touches the local file system — the scope is the Linear cloud workspace (issues/projects/teams).
axes.background: The service lives on Linear's side; request-response semantics, no background tasks.
axes.tools:
Search/read/create/update issues, query projects and teams, comments, etc.; write capabilities are complete (create issues, change status).
The complete inventory follows the official docs; it has not been enumerated item by item.
axes.context: No server-side cross-session memory — state lives in the Linear workspace itself.
axes.permissions:
OAuth user auth: the agent-visible surface = the connected Linear account's permissions; write operations take effect directly,
and there is no official docs for a tool-level approval mechanism — before hooking up an agent, defend on the assumption "it can create and edit issues for you".
axes.fit:
Fits: coding agents creating/updating issues as they finish work, pulling "what did this requirement say back then" from Linear.
Not a fit: strict write control needing approval flows; non-Linear stacks.

mcp.transport:
**Streamable HTTP** (mcp.linear.app/mcp); the old SSE endpoint is retired (direct fetch 404 verified).
Verified: linear.app/docs/mcp 200, endpoint 401 (2026-10-21).
mcp.auth:
OAuth browser authorization flow (log into the Linear account on first connection); no official docs for a plaintext-PAT configuration route.
Authorization granularity and token-revocation details not verified item by item.
mcp.scope:
Read surface: issue search/read, project and team queries; write surface: create/update issues, comments.
It follows the account's permissions; there is no separate approval layer.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/mcp/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/mcp/_protocol.md).
unknowns:
- The full tool inventory (not enumerated item by item)
- Rate-limit details (official gives no numbers)
- The workspace-level control surface (not verified item by item)
related: Both the "task surface for coding agents": GitHub manages PRs/issues on the code side, Linear manages the product-issues side.
sources: Linear · official MCP docs (endpoint and auth wording, direct-fetched and verified 2026-10-21)
